_comment: Single source of truth for the AI-crawler policy. build_site.py generates robots.txt from this; verify_site.py checks robots.txt matches it AND that every token appears in content/ai-crawler-policy.md. Change a decision here, then update the policy page table.
_source: Vendor crawler documentation: https://platform.openai.com/docs/bots, https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/8896518-does-anthropic-crawl-data-from-the-web-and-how-can-site-owners-block-the-crawler, https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/bots, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/google-common-crawlers, https://support.apple.com/en-us/119829

notes.Google-Extended: Allowed as a disclosed trade-off: it governs Gemini grounding (a citation channel) as well as Gemini training. Google states it has no effect on Google Search inclusion or ranking.
notes.Applebot-Extended: Apple documents this token as the training opt-out; disallowing it leaves the site in Spotlight, Siri and Safari search.
notes.ClaudeBot: Anthropic's training crawler. Its search crawler is Claude-SearchBot, which is allowed.
notes.OAI-AdsBot: Only visits pages submitted as ads; this site runs no ads, so it is allowed and harmless.
